name: Ether Wisp
source:
A mutant of the will-o-wisp race whose life is dependant on Ether energy. She is the operator of the Sorcerous City of Energeia, and is one of Theofrad's bodyguards.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
